syllabus_topics: Introduction to telecommunication systems: fundamental components of a digital transmission system; types of services and their characterization; general principles of telecommunication system design.
Mobile communications: channel characterization; power balance and radio resource management techniques; multiple access; cellular mobile generations (2G, 3G, 4G and 5G).
Satellite communications: link characterization; orbits; power balance; performance analysis.
Optical communications: link elements; transmission windows; optical fiber structure; attenuation; distortion; fiber types; optical sources; receiver structure; performance analysis.
Multimedia systems: image and video coding and transmission.

assessment_methods.method: Two MAP30 assessments during theoretical classes
Bibliographical research project with oral presentation

assessment_rules: For regular students, the assessment consists of quizzes (5%), two MAP30 assessments (30%), a bibliographical research project with oral presentation (25%), and a final exam (40%). For student-workers, the assessment consists of a bibliographical research project with oral presentation (25%) and a final exam (75%). In the resit period, students can choose between the regular assessment method or the student-worker method. In the special period, the assessment consists of a bibliographical research project with oral presentation (25%) and a final exam (75%). The minimum grade for the final exam is 8 values. The final grade for approval must be at least 9.5 values.
